article.title: Illuminating Faulting Complexity of the 2017 Yellowstone Maple Creek Earthquake Swarm
article.scientific_question: Resolve dense Maple Creek swarm detection, relative hypocenter geometry, migration and focal-mechanism complexity beyond the routine catalog.
article.sequence: 2017 Yellowstone Maple Creek swarm; largest event Mw 4.4 on 2017-06-16; study detections June–September 2017.
article.catalog_relationship: Genuine catalog-construction paper; article event populations and local USGS phase-arrival release are related but not the same product.

product_semantics.article_product: 15,912 well-located and 30,411 magnitude populations are article-reported and not recoverable from local phase CSV.
product_semantics.local_product: `match_id` repeats across station/phase rows; `arrival` is epoch seconds from template pick plus differential time.
product_semantics.window_count_rule: Report phase rows and unique IDs separately; 23,660 is an ID count, not event count.

units.mag: repeated numeric value with invalid/extreme rows

evidence.note: Article event table is not the downloaded CSV and is not staged.

catalog.quality_tier_detail: High-quality relative geometry and template-enhanced detection; the local phase release is an auxiliary observation table.

construction_workflow.summary: Routine UUSS events become waveform templates; continuous matched filtering yields correlation/differential times, hypoDD relocates events, observation-count thresholds define article populations, and amplitudes/polarities support magnitude and focal mechanisms.

input_data.name: UUSS routine catalog and phase picks
input_data.channels_sampling: 100 Hz article processing; exact channel-day inventory unavailable
input_data.availability_conditions: 2,289 routine template events; local CSV has 1,147 template IDs.

input_data.name: continuous waveforms
input_data.availability_conditions: Station availability changes; local release has 29 full-file pairs and 27 in frozen window.

stages.name: template formation
stages.purpose: Build waveform templates from routine catalog events.
stages.method: 2–15 Hz bandpass, 100 Hz templates; local release template IDs are not equivalent to article count.

evidence.locator: Observation and network conditions; Catalog-construction workflow

stages.name: continuous matched filtering
stages.purpose: Detect template-like events and measure differential times.
stages.method: Continuous matched-filter scans at 0.01-s increments; weights use correlation coefficient, daily MAD and nearby-peak separation.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Article reports 34.1M correlation and 1.3M routine-catalog differential times.

stages.name: hypoDD relative relocation
stages.method: Double-difference relocation with >=50 P and >=50 S observations for well-located population.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Well-located threshold defines article relative-location population.

evidence.locator: Catalog-construction workflow; Article-reported quality and limitations

stages.name: magnitude and focal-mechanism products
stages.purpose: Estimate relative amplitudes and cluster focal-mechanism polarities.
stages.method: Magnitude superset uses >=15 P and >=30 S observations; polarity clustering/HASH variant is downstream interpretation.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Do not treat focal-mechanism clusters as independent truth.

construction_workflow.final_output: Article-level event catalog is not locally staged; local machine-readable product is phase-only USGS release.

related_products.name: USGS/UUSS operational baseline

scientific_findings.statement: The local release cannot support spatial/depth event summaries because it lacks event-origin fields; article-level populations must remain separate.

benchmark_context.quality_interpretation: Article Q1 relative geometry/Q2 enhanced detection; local phase release Q4 auxiliary.
benchmark_context.recommended_role: Use article event table when acquired; use current CSV only for phase/timing diagnostics.

benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Phase timing, template lineage, event geometry after event table acquisition.
benchmark_context.caveats: 23,660 frozen IDs are not validated event count; no spatial mask can be applied locally.
